program.name: Court Athlete
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: For court sports: agility drills, lateral leg strength and landing control in every session.
program.about: Everything a court sport asks of the legs in one session. Agility drills come first, shuttles, carioca and split steps; then lateral leg strength such as Cossack squats and Copenhagen planks; then balance and landing drills that protect knees and ankles. No equipment. Abs finish day A. Levels II and III add reps and time.
